status: Class 1, Open, Classified (FDA posted 2026-11-02; was Early Alert 2026-10-15)
reason: Commander M delivery system for SAPIEN M3: manufacturing issue which may result in cardiovascular balloon rupturing (balloon burst during use); product removal of lots 67718561, 67804014, 67887043, 67887044 only. FDA Early Alert reported 1 death and 1 serious injury as of Oct 5, 2026. 164 units in US commerce.
